reviewer: finish_assembly_position_repairs; separate implementation reviewer, independent of draft and replacement author
scope: Complete revised values independently reread against the complete English source and checked sources; not approval based on a changed fragment alone.

entries.source: The selected image is no longer in this assembly.
entries.target: Kién tó ke thù-siong yí-kîn mò chhai yá chak phîn-chiap tú.
entries.complete_value: Selected/resultative Kién tó modifies image; yí-kîn supplies the changed/already state, mò chhai negates continuing location, and yá chak phîn-chiap tú identifies this assembly interior. Complete sentence preserves the no-longer-in-this-assembly condition.
entries.evidence: Authored PFS text by Tseng Kuei-hai, transcribed by Chiu Shu-hua, directly read at https://hakka.fhl.net/Iahap/Iahap24.html, line 61: yí kîn. H5 resultative source and original independent whole-value review retained.

entries.source: Set the top-left corner of this image on the output canvas. X and Y are whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their current positions. Overlap is allowed here; images imported later are drawn on top. The canvas expands to include all placed images. Crops and sizes stay unchanged.
entries.target: Siat-tēng chit tiuⁿ tô͘-phìⁿ chó-siōng-kak tī su-chhut ōe-pò͘ ê ūi-tì. X kah Y ēng chéng-sò͘ siōng-sò͘ lâi sǹg, tùi lêng khai-sí. Kî-tha tô͘-phìⁿ ē lâu leh chit-má ê ūi-tì. Chit ūi ē-tàng sio-tha̍h; khah āu hōe-ji̍p ê tô͘-phìⁿ ē ōe tī téng-koân. Ōe-pò͘ ē khok-tāi, hō͘ só͘-ū khǹg hó ê tô͘-phìⁿ lóng khǹg ē lo̍h. Chhâi-chhiat kah chhùn-chhioh bē kái.
entries.complete_value: Set this image top-left corner on output canvas; X/Y integer pixels calculated from zero; other images retain present locations; overlap allowed here; images imported later are drawn above; canvas expands to fit every placed image; crop and dimensions remain unchanged. Each clause was reread as one complete paragraph. The revised dimensions compound chhùn-chhioh does not alter crop/size invariance.
entries.evidence: Directly read MOE full term tshùn-tshioh at https://sutian.moe.edu.tw/zh-hant/su/259/ and the primary 2024 astronomy-terminology paper by Tsai An-li, printed p179/table25, https://www.tcll.ntnu.edu.tw/twnica/downloadfile.php?issue_id=27&paper_id=182&periodicalsDir=DESC&periodicalsOrder=Sorter_issue_ch. These support the native reversed compound order beyond clothing; whole paragraph is composition, not an attested quotation.

limits: Bounded semantic/idiomatic acceptance, no native-speaker, runtime or layout certification.
